provenance: Transcribed from the six Gherkin scenarios in scopes.md. Every linkedTests entry names a persistent test declaration; structural evidence remains separately cited in report.md and no implementation file is presented as a test.

scenarios.title: Tier-A stamps the analyzed window cutoff and preserves the run clock

gherkin.given: the morning window declares an 11:00 ET evidence cutoff
gherkin.when: a Tier-A run executes at 11:37 ET and publishes that window
gherkin.then: the snapshot asOf is the 11:00 ET cutoff and the snapshot generatedAt is the 11:37 ET run instant

linkedTests.testId: Regression: SCN-008-006 all four exact ET windows preserve cutoff and composition time
SCN-008-006 TP-05-01: each window is identified from the generic config and no later observation enters an earlier cutoff

scenarios.title: Publisher and consumer resolve the same declared window cutoff

gherkin.given: the publisher and the consumer both need the cutoff of a declared window
gherkin.then: both call the same exported helper and neither restates the declared ET times as literals

linkedTests.testId: SCN-008-046 complete generic evidence validates all five inputs and resolves DST by New York civil time
Regression: SCN-008-006 all four exact ET windows preserve cutoff and composition time

scenarios.coverageNote: The linked tests exercise cutoff resolution on both DST sides and through the browser consumer. The single-definition wiring evidence is recorded separately at report.md#one-cutoff-rule.

scenarios.title: A publication later than its declared cutoff is refused by name

gherkin.given: a publication whose asOf is later than the cutoff of the window it declares
gherkin.when: the brief tab composes its evidence window
gherkin.then: composition is refused with P008-BRIEF-EVIDENCE / generic-evidence-cutoff-conflict and no lane, action, or identity is invented to fill the gap

linkedTests.testId: Regression: BUG-001 a publication later than its declared window cutoff is refused by name and never empties the schedule

scenarios.title: The public schedule survives a refused evidence window

gherkin.given: the public schedule has loaded and composition is then refused
gherkin.when: the reader looks at the evidence-window selector
gherkin.then: it still offers every declared window and the refusal is named on screen rather than presented as an empty tab

linkedTests.testId: Regression: BUG-001 a publication later than its declared window cutoff is refused by name and never empties the schedule

scenarios.title: The cockpit renders publication time from generatedAt

gherkin.given: asOf and generatedAt now carry different instants
gherkin.when: the cockpit renders the publication clock
gherkin.then: it reads snapshotRef.generatedAt and it does not read payloadRef.asOf

linkedTests.testId: Regression: SCN-008-006 all four exact ET windows preserve cutoff and composition time
SCN-008-006 TP-05-01: each window is identified from the generic config and no later observation enters an earlier cutoff

scenarios.title: A missing published cutoff fails instead of being re-clocked

gherkin.given: a snapshot that carries no asOf
gherkin.when: a lockstep consumer builds a payload from it
gherkin.then: it fails loudly and it does not substitute the run wall-clock

linkedTests.testId: SCN-008-046 complete generic evidence validates all five inputs and resolves DST by New York civil time
Regression: BUG-001 a publication later than its declared window cutoff is refused by name and never empties the schedule

scenarios.coverageNote: The linked tests require complete cutoff-bearing generic evidence and prove that a run-clock value past the declared cutoff is refused. The explicit absent-asOf fail-loud branch is recorded separately at report.md#no-wall-clock-fallback; no implementation file is presented as a test.
